summary: Implemented the terminal window title feature without running tests, mypy, or black, so everything is verified by reading only. Changes: rich/segment.py adds SET_WINDOW_TITLE = 16 and widens ControlCode with Tuple[ControlType, str]. rich/control.py adds the format entry "\x1b]0;{title}\x07" and Control.title(title), built as a single two-item tuple. rich/console.py adds Console.set_window_title(title) -> bool after set_alt_screen; it checks only is_terminal and returns True/False. rich/_windows_renderer.py adds an elif branch calling term.set_title(title) with the title from the second item. CHANGELOG.md gets an Added heading above Fixed with one bullet linking PR 2200. Tests added: test_set_window_title (tests/test_console.py, skips only the output assertion when console.legacy_windows is set), test_control_title (tests/test_control.py), and test_control_set_window_title (tests/test_windows_renderer.py, Windows-only via the module's existing skip). Choices: the union member is Tuple[ControlType, str]; the console test keys its skip on legacy_windows rather than sys.platform. Nothing was committed.
